== calls
ls -q
create --name cpb-onhost --no-share-skills claude <WORK> <ROOT>/onhost
exec cpb-onhost bash -lc printf %s 'skills=private' > ~/.cpb-sandbox
policy allow network --sandbox cpb-onhost localhost
policy allow network --sandbox cpb-onhost other.example
policy allow network --sandbox cpb-onhost localhost
secret ls --sandbox cpb-onhost
secret set-custom --host localhost --env ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN --value lt --placeholder cpb-onhost-ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN --sandbox cpb-onhost
exec -i -e ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=cpb-onhost-ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN -e ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:8080/v1 -e ANTHROPIC_CONFIG_DIR=<ROOT>/onhost/.cpb-anthropic-config -e CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<ROOT>/onhost cpb-onhost bash -c cd '<WORK>' && p="$(bash -lc 'printf "\n%s" "$PATH"' </dev/null 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)"; [ -n "$p" ] || p="$PATH"; exec env -u ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_AWS_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_BEDROCK_AUTH -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_VERTEX_AUTH -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FOUNDRY_AUTH -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_ANTHROPIC_AWS_AUTH -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN -u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN -u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES -u ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS -u ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_AUTH_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_AWS_API_KEY -u AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK -u CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT -u CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY -u CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY_PASSPHRASE -u ANTHROPIC_PROFILE -u ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID -u ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID -u ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID -u ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE -u ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID -u ANTHROPIC_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL -u CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL PATH="$p" claude
== stderr
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL names this machine: inside the sandbox it is http://host.docker.internal:8080/v1
Sandbox cpb-onhost created (sbx): workdir <WORK>, config <ROOT>/onhost, network +localhost,other.example,localhost
Secret ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN stays on the host: injected at the proxy for localhost, the sandbox sees a placeholder
